captions.en: I was class president all through school, just so I could ask questions.
I wanted the stage, so every year I danced at the talent show in sunglasses.
In the U.S., I asked so many questions I got limited to two a day.
For a year, I went to every classroom and pestered my teachers,
and that's how I ranked 2nd in my school.

captions.small: 학부 시절, 강의가 끝나면 무조건 질문
captions.en: In college, I asked a question after every lecture, and that's how I landed every project.

captions.small: 첫 직장 창립 멤버로 대표님들을 인터뷰하며
captions.en: As a founding member at my first job, I interviewed CEOs. Asking questions became my job.
